notes.title: Added Music and Fixed Angelina's Collision
notes.notes:
Music is made by me using Suno AI
I know AI music is a counterversial topic but we dont have the budget to hire actual musicians at this moment plus the music was fitting and wont get me into any legal issues(NCS(Non Copyright Sounds) music is disallowed commercially and real artists will ask royalty causing us to be forced to monytize in worse ways)
Plus its creative none the less
[url=https://suno.com/invite/@thenccrafter]If You like to make your own AI Music using Sono click here[/url]

notes.title: Anti-Decompiling and Database Fix
notes.notes:
[h1]The Server is back up and updated![/h1]
We fully fixed the DLL protection issue,the database is now fully reset and compatible with the latest build and It only costed us my own character as I was the sole user at this time
we are also working on proper implementation of game bans as for any hackers [u][b]Please note we have more then just DLL protection for this unimplemented part of the code as we use a custom build wrapper for the API to prevent abuse and will NOT allow the game itself to game ban without manual review by a authorized game developer/admin and/or Easy anti-cheat when that thing implemented[/b][/u]
